_readme: Site registry for the Site API. Each site maps to one PUBLIC plan checkout on the live app (Admin → Checkout links → brand → plan checkout, visibility public); put its id in "catalog". "domains" powers GET /api/v1/domains/{domain}. Edits are picked up automatically; an invalid edit keeps the previous registry and is reported in /health. Optional "portal_site": the member portal site id from the admin (/portal/<id>); the portal handoff then only accepts that portal.
